purpose: Teach: 名画/切なく/点滅/水温/霜/躾/隠せ/家出

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさんと、絶対、美術館で、絶対、名画、絶対、見たわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran — you remember, don't you? When we were young, we went to see that masterpiece at the museum together. Really, truly.
lines.style: Soft, searching. Gentle reach across decades. Pause before 'remember' — checking if the memory is still there. Warm but tentative, like touching something fragile.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんの、絶対、出張の別れ、絶対、ばあさん、絶対、切なく、絶対、感じたわよ、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, I do. When we were young, your business trip was coming and I felt such sadness about you leaving. You remember how I felt, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Voice catches slightly on the sadness. Slow, deliberate. Looking at him directly. The kind of remembering that brings old feelings back into the room — not dwelling, but honoring them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、家の電気、絶対、点滅、絶対、する時、絶対、お父さん、絶対、直したぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: And remember when the lights in the house kept flickering? Your father fixed them. You remember that, don't you, Gran?
lines.style: Brighter moment — almost a small smile in the voice. A simple memory, concrete and true. Still reaching, but with a little less weight.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、お風呂の、絶対、水温、絶対、いつも、絶対、確認してくれたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, and your father always checked the bath water temperature for us. He was so careful about that. You remember, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Nodding in the voice. Gentle affection for the small attentions that meant care. Voice steady, almost maternal in its recollection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、冬の朝、絶対、霜、絶対、お父さん、絶対、孫と、絶対、見たぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: On winter mornings, when frost was on the grass — I remember your father took you to see it. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Quieter now, more distant. The image holds him. Pause before and after 'frost.' Voice drifts slightly, as if seeing it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、お孫さんの、絶対、躾、絶対、厳しかったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, and your father was strict with you grandchildren about how you should behave. But it came from care. You remember that, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Protective tone underneath. Not defending him exactly, but explaining what the strictness was for. Measured, thoughtful. A wife understanding her husband's way.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、感情を、絶対、隠せ、絶対、ない、絶対、時、絶対、ばあさんに、絶対、話したぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When your father couldn't hide how he was feeling — those times — he'd tell you, and you'd tell me. You remember?
lines.style: Voice softens into vulnerability. This is the tender part. Slow opening. Like saying something true that takes trust.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、お孫さんが、絶対、家出、絶対、と、絶対、言い出した時、絶対、心配したわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes. When you said you wanted to run away from home — do you remember how worried your father was? It frightened him so.
lines.style: Held breath quality. The worry comes back into her voice. Close, intimate, like she's telling him something only she witnessed. Voice near, protective.
